home.title: Meme Court
home.subtitle: Defend the weirdest cases on the internet.
home.description: Choose evidence, cross-examine witnesses, and convince the AI Judge with your most chaotic arguments.
examples: A raccoon accused of pizza theft
A cat charged with emotional manipulation
An AI sued for terrible dating advice
A duck claiming ownership of the moon
A pizza box testifying in its own defense

loading.title: Court is in session...
messages: The AI Judge is reviewing the chaos…
The witness is trying to remember what happened…
Adjusting the judge's emotional stability settings…
Locating the defendant (last seen near the snack table)…

evidence.title: Choose Your Evidence
evidence.subtitle: Pick 2 pieces of evidence to support your defense. Choose wisely.

witness.title: Cross-Examine the Witness
witness.subtitle: The witness looks nervous. Or dramatic. Or both. Choose your approach.

defense.title: Final Defense
defense.subtitle: Write your closing argument. Be logical, funny, dramatic, or completely unhinged.
defense.inputPlaceholder: Example: My client is innocent because the evidence is suspicious and the vibes are off.

presets.0: My client was clearly framed by forces beyond our understanding.
presets.1: The evidence proves nothing except that my client has excellent taste.
presets.2: Your Honor, I present the concept of vibes as my primary argument.

verdict.title: Final Verdict
verdict.subtitle: The AI Judge has spoken.

errors.aiUnavailable: The AI Judge stepped out for a moment. Using backup case files.

rebuttal.title: The Witness Fights Back
rebuttal.subtitle: Your questioning provoked a response. The witness has more to say.
rebuttal.moodNote: The judge is watching how you handle this. Stay composed.
